name: Forest Lakes Winter Holiday Market
label: Craft market
description: A fun and family friendly holiday market with over 45+ vendors, food trucks and more. Stop in for that last minute gift for someone or get something special for yourself. Local vendors with a wide variety of items - produce, beef, pork, poultry, eggs, jams, baked goods, local honey, coffee, chocolates, jewelry, pottery, woodwork, crochet, art, and a wide variety of other crafts. Leashed pets welcome
